regions.contentLimits: One title and one supporting description.
regions.overflow: Wrap actions below the title at compact width.

responsive.compact: Stack header actions and preserve a 44px minimum target.
responsive.wide: Keep the page header and primary action on one row.

focus.onOpen: Move focus to the first control in the opened surface.
focus.onClose: Return focus to the control that opened the surface.
focus.onError: Move focus to the first invalid field or the error summary.

accessibility.headings: One h1 followed by ordered section headings.
accessibility.labels: Every control has a visible or programmatic label and associated description.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Loading, save, and error results use the appropriate status channel.
